title: Milt Shaw's threat at Gothenburg; Lorraine becomes Dizzy's manager
summary: Billy Shaw's son threatened him on the tender into Gothenburg; Clarke urged Lorraine to manage Dizzy herself, and she has done so ever since.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So after all this came up, all these things, so we arrived in Sweden, and his father made him come back. He was supposed to travel with us. All this 20,000, or $27,000.00, I forget exactly how much money, but I know it was a large sum of money, he was supposed to travel with the band and all. So when we arrived in Göteborg, we came off on a tender. We put all the instruments on the tender, you know, because the boat was like a mile out, you know.
So we had a concert that night, so we came in on a tender.
So we couldn't go through all the passport regulations.

So they rode us in on the tender. So while we were riding in I was standing on the edge of the boat, looking over at the sea, you know, admiring it. You know, it's like a return to something I had known 10 years before, and I was enjoying.

And Milt tried to push me off of the boat. And Al McKibben was sitting like -- you know, I was standing here, and like this was the rail of the boat, so Al was sitting inside like this, you know, beside me. Because we had been talking. I was saying, "I remember this, and I remember this." So he runs up to push me, and Al says, "Look out, Kenny," and he grabbed him. I said, "What are you trying to do, man? Are you crazy." So he looked at me and said, "I'll kill you." So Al McKibben said, "No, you won't, either. You must be crazy, are you kidding?" So then his father sent for him to go back, because he was mad because I had exposed this whole thing. He was very angry about it. So then Lorraine, I told Lorraine, I said, "Look, Lorraine. You need those people like a hole in the head." So Lorraine became Dizzy's manager. I said, "All you have to do is go to the union and pay $5.00 and you become a manager." And she said, "That's what I'm going to do." And she's been managing Dizzy ever since, and Dizzy never made so much money in his life.

They were stealing it from him. So Lorraine said, "They won't steal any more, because I'm going to manage it from now on out," you know. So that's why we're real tight. Lorraine, she is -- I love her, because she got the message immediately. She says, "Oh, they won't rob Dizzy, not while I'm alive." And she manages his affairs right till
now. She -- sometimes I go there and she's in paper work up to there.
But she takes care of all his business, answers his letters, makes the prices, does everything. Can you imagine that?
And that's what it springs from.
